product_metadata.title: Rachael Ray Bakeware Nonstick Cookie Pan Set, 3-Piece, Gray with Red Grips
features: EASY FOOD RELEASE: Roasting pan set features long-lasting all-over nonstick for excellent food release and easy cleanup, allowing for years of enjoyment.
FEEL GOOD BAKING SET: A portion of the proceeds goes to Yum-o!(r), Rachael’s nonprofit that helps kids and parents develop healthy relationships with food.
LONG-LASTING COOKIE PAN SET: Baking pan set is made from durable steel that resists warping. This set is dishwasher safe for easy cleanup, though hand washing is recommended.
GET A GRIP: Bold-colored, extra-wide grippy handles on the 3-piece sheet set provides a confident grasp. Oven safe to 500 degrees Fahrenheit.
PRODUCT DETAILS: 3-Piece Set includes 9-Inch x 13-Inch Cookie Pan, 10-Inch x 15-Inch Cookie Pan, 11-Inch x 17-Inch Cookie Pan, Durable Steel. Quality assurance guarantee.
description: Offering three popular-sized nonstick baking pans, the Rachael Ray 47423 Bakeware 3-Piece Nonstick Cookie Pan Set is ideal for making both savory and sweet treats. These cookie pans are made from durable steel that resists warping and feature long-lasting nonstick that provides excellent food release and easy cleanup. With a small, medium, and large cookie sheet, enjoy the convenience of three sizes to do everything. The nonstick baking sheet set features bold-colored, extra-wide grippy handles that provide a confident grasp when pulling items from the oven and are oven safe to 500°F. Hit a triple play with the Rachael Ray 47423 Bakeware 3-Piece Nonstick Cookie Pan Set that includes three durable baking pans for creating delish baked foods.
